# msl_origin (Resource)

Manages an MSL5 **Origin** resource (`/api/v1/origins`). Origins define the ingest server location and configuration for live streaming.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `contract_id` (String) Akamai contract ID (e.g. `A-123456`). Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.
- `cptag` (String) CP code tag. Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.
- `group_id` (String) Group identifier for the origin. Updatable in-place.
- `host_name` (String) Unique hostname identifier for this origin. Must be non-empty and unique across the system. Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.
- `ingest_location` (String) Primary ingest zone in `REGION_ZONE` format (e.g. `US_ORD`, `US_SEA`, `GB_LON`). Must be non-empty. Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.

### Optional

- `backup_ingest_location` (String) Optional backup ingest zone in `REGION_ZONE` format (e.g. `US_SEA`, `GB_LON`). Must differ from `ingest_location`. Immutable: can only be set during resource creation.
- `shared_keys` (Block List) Up to 10 shared keys for token-authenticated ingest. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--shared_keys))

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The account ID associated with the origin, as returned by the MSL5 API.
- `backup_host_name` (String) Backup encoder hostname assigned by MSL5.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of when the origin was created.
- `created_by` (String) The user who created the origin.
- `id` (String) The unique origin ID assigned by the MSL5 API (`origin_id`).
- `status` (String) Current status of the origin (e.g. `READY`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of the last update.

<a id="nestedblock--shared_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shared_keys`

Required:

- `host_name` (String) Hostname that this shared key applies to.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The shared key secret value.
- `name` (String) Descriptive name of this shared key entry. Must be between 1 and 8 characters.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this shared key is active. Defaults to `true`.




## Import

```bash
terraform import msl_origin.primary <origin_id>
```
